snapshot.name: Carnegie Mellon 2026-2027 Undergraduate Research Opportunities (Projects List)
snapshot.publisher: Carnegie Mellon University, Office of Undergraduate Research and Scholar Development
snapshot.access: The sheet opens only for a CMU Andrew (@andrew.cmu.edu) Google login; no collector can fetch it.
snapshot.publisher_note: Please note that these lists may not be updated as positions are filled.
snapshot.kept_from_the_sheet: Per project only a short title written from its synopsis, the person who listed it (name, position, department), the date it was listed, and how to reach that person: an address the listing writes for them or the one they listed it from, or the form or page it links. The sheet's synopses, preferred skills, keywords, end dates and inquiry instructions are not copied, and neither is any address a listing gives for someone else.
snapshot.captured_from: PDF export of the sheet's Projects List tab (5 pages, 39 responses, the newest submitted 2026-09-11); the export is not committed.

excluded_responses.reason: A University of Pittsburgh response (Pathology), not a CMU listing; left out, as in the contributed import.
